Long Haul

Re-autorização de rota

An amended ATC clearance that modifies the previously cleared route, typically issued to avoid weather, airspace restrictions, or traffic.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Re-autorização de rota?

In this glossary, Re-autorização de rota refers to: An amended ATC clearance that modifies the previously cleared route, typically issued to avoid weather, airspace restrictions, or traffic.

How is Re-autorização de rota used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Controle Delhi, VTI311 solicita Re-autorização de rota para evitar atividade convectiva sobre Karachi e prosseguir pela aerovia R460."

Why does Re-autorização de rota matter in aviation?

Re-autorização de rota matters because it supports clear communication in Long Haul contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses Re-autorização de rota?

Re-autorização de rota is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

Definition

An amended ATC clearance that modifies the previously cleared route, typically issued to avoid weather, airspace restrictions, or traffic.

Operational example

Delhi Control, VTI311 requests Route Reclearance to avoid convective activity over Karachi and proceed via airway R460.

Localized term

Re-autorização de rota
